steps.message: Execute: adb shell "dumpsys activity providers | grep -i -A3 -B3 org.tasks; for u in content://org.tasks content://org.tasks/tasks content://org.tasks/lists content://org.tasks.instances content://org.tasks.provider content://org.tasks.provider/tasks content://org.tasks.provider/lists; do echo ==== $u ====; content query --uri $u 2>&1 | head -n 20; done"
